rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for incense, with context supplying whether it means the material or its fragrant smoke.

example.english: Remember to light incense before worshipping.
example.jyutping: baai3 san4 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 dim2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically want to foreground the smoke from burning incense rather than the incense material itself.

example.english: The fragrant smoke from the incense drifted into the house, making the whole room smell nice.
example.traditional: 香煙飄入屋企，成間房都香晒。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 jin1 piu1 jap6 uk1 kei2 seng4 gaan1 fong4 dou1 hoeng1 saai3
